note: Mark Twain National Forest campground on one loop in the woods just north of the Highway 19 bridge over the Eleven Point National Scenic River, used mostly by floaters; the boat launch is one of the river's busiest. Greer Spring and Greer Mill are a short drive north. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 16 single + 3 double sites, $10 ($20 doubles), 50% Senior/Access, no hookups, vault toilets, water Apr 1-Nov 1, January-December, rig 60 (printed 60"), no rec.gov listing (FCFS kept). Riverview not supported: FS 'set back away from the water's edge', loop 60-80 m from the river through continuous forest, no official photo -> not waterfront. Phone 573-996-2153 to add. Pin ~90 m from loop centre, fine.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (riverview -> not waterfront): the FS page says 'The campground is set back away from the water's edge.' Imagery: the campsite loop (~170 x 150 m) sits on a wooded bench; its south side is ~60-80 m from the Eleven Point River across continuous forest, and the boat launch/day-use lot lies between the loop's west side and the river. The FS page has no campsite photo (only a canoeing photo and an unrelated lake photo), so no official photo shows the river from a site, and distance alone does not earn a view. Goes down to not waterfront.
PHONE (to add): FS page 'Eleven Point/Doniphan Ranger District ... Phone: 573-996-2153'. None stored.
RIG LENGTH: 'Vehicle + towed Trailers cannot exceed 60" in length' - inches is plainly a typo for feet (asphalt parking for a loop of trailer sites); kept as max_rig_ft 60, a 23-ft rig fits.
FCFS: no reservation wording on the FS page, and recreation.gov search finds no Greer Crossing facility; first-come (reservable false, fcfs always) confirmed per the README rule.
PIN: stored 36.7940,-91.3295 is at the loop's NW corner by the entrance junction, ~90 m from the FS point (36.79356,-91.32854, mid-loop); fine.
STATUS: page shows 'Site Open'; the forest's current alerts (Paddy Creek bridge, Trail 119, Beaver Lake, Red Bridge Road) don't touch Greer Crossing or Highway 19.
